data.name: Hollow

main: His passive automatically lets him generate 1 {st:BulletHole} every turn even without using it first. It costs 0 resources at 5 stacks. On use, he gains {st:BlackWingHole} and starts generating it every turn. The buff gives him {st:Charge} Count and {st:AttackUp} every turn plus some bonus damage for {st:Charge} and {st:Breath} skills.
His awakening consumes SP to generate {st:BulletHole} so he always has 5 on use (this should not bypass E.G.O resources). He consumes all stacks while executing the attack.

His corrosion's 2nd coin's heads chance depends on his {st:BulletHole} stacks. If it flips heads, he generates 2 stacks, some {st:Breath}, and refunds some resources, but doesn't deal damage. If it flips tails, he consumes all stacks and deals significant damage.
other: His passive heals his SP and gives him {st:ResultEnhancement} whenever he consumes 3 {st:Bullet}

passiveList.desc:
[AlwaysUseEGOPassive]
If this unit has 5 [BulletHole], does not consume E.G.O Resource when using "Hollow" E.G.O's Skills (both Awakening and Corrosion)

Turn Start: Gain 1 [BulletHole]

[WhenUseEGOPassive]
Turn Start: Gain 1 [BlackWingHole]

Heal 5 SP every time this unit consumes or loses 3 cumulative [Bullet], and gain 1 [ResultEnhancement] next turn (including Unique [Bullet]; counts up to 9 [Bullet] per turn)
passiveList.flavor:
The gaze of another nails into me, driving a hollow from which multitudes spill forth.
The discharge is then forged into a bullet that punches a hollow into you.
passiveList.name: L'Hémorragie interne
